findings.message: The emit_event at plugin.result emission does not include draft status or the reason draft was forced (failed_status or max_iterations), so operators cannot identify forced-draft events in structured logs without inspecting pr-result.json manually.

The existing-PR update path (gh pr edit) does not pass --draft or call gh pr convert-to-draft, so a failed re-run that finds an existing non-draft PR updates the body with the convergence warning but leaves the PR as non-draft, violating the issue's requirement that a failed run never presents its output as ready to merge.

The convergence and gate warning blocks (_extra) are appended after 'Generated by zBuild automation.' at the end of the PR body, reducing operator visibility of the non-convergence alert compared to the issue's example placement.
